title: RunArtifact
description: The complete result of one evaluation run.

comparisons.description:
Cross-scanner differential observations, sorted by
`(case_id, variant, reference, peer)`.

manifest.description: Every identity needed to reproduce the run.

non_semantic.description: Timestamps and host diagnostics. Excluded from the semantic digest.

review_queue.description:
Occurrences that need an authored decision (differential
disagreements and variants whose expectation could not be derived),
sorted by `id`. Never a verdict on any scanner.

scanners.description: Per-scanner results, sorted by scanner id.

variants.description:
Generated variants (mutation/metamorphic/twin methods), sorted by
`(case_id, variant)`. Empty when no generating method ran.

AccountedCounts.description: Resolution counts for a stratum of assertions.

AccountingConfig.description:
Engine v1.1 accounting parameters (legacy `AccountingConfig`,
`benchmarks/types.ts:55-58`, values in `qualification/suite-v1.json`).
Floors withhold rates as `insufficient-evidence`/`insufficient-coverage`;
they are measurement rules, not support thresholds.

interval_precision.description: Decimal places of published points and bounds (1..=12).

interval_z.description: z value of the Wilson interval.

min_denominator.description: Smallest denominator for which a rate is published.

resolved_rate_floor.description: Minimum resolved share per method stratum.

twin_coverage_floor.description: Minimum twin coverage (pairs / positives) per kind.

version.description:
Adapter implementation version. Changes whenever parsing or offset
conversion changes.

by_target.description:
Per-target groups: for each target family, the `<kind>/<tier>` groups
of the cases that target it, accounted over the corpus groups that
hold them (a selected positive's twin and the selection's `T0` cases
travel with the group; legacy `selectionGroups`).

groups.description:
Case groups keyed `<kind>/<tier>` (e.g. `must-redact/T1`), with all
`T0` cases in `pending/T0`. No cross-group totals.

resolution_by_target.description:
Per-target assertion resolution, keyed like `resolution`
(cases without targets count under `unassigned`).

Assertion.description: A method assertion for one scanner.

oneOf.description: Assertion held.
Assertion failed.
Expectation pending an authored decision.
The scanner never observed the variant; consumes denominator.
Placeholder type for review-required / not-measured absolute assertions.
Positive: every span EXACT/COVERED and zero collateral bytes.
Control: not flagged.
Relation: baseline and candidate both pass with identical readings.
Relation: positive baseline passes and secret-free candidate passes.
Upper bound (lower is better).
Lower bound (higher is better).
Contains secret spans that must be covered.
A control: any (scoped) finding is a false alarm.

Contains spans whose handling is a policy matter; scored like
`must-redact` but grouped separately.

CaseMeasurement.description:
Per-case measurement. The variant is decided by the case, not the scanner:
cases with a secret span are positives, cases without are controls, `T0`
cases are pending, and a non-complete scanner yields `not-measured`.

oneOf.description: A case with at least one secret span.

collateral_bytes.description: Finding bytes outside every acceptable range (spans or envelopes).

leaked_bytes.description: Secret bytes not covered by any finding, summed over leaked spans.

span_outcomes.description: One outcome per secret span, in span order.

oneOf.description: A case without secret spans (benign control or twin).

action_counts.description: Tally of scanner-reported actions on the case's findings.

co_detected.description: Twin only: a finding attributed to a different, known family fired.

findings.description: Number of deduplicated findings on the case.

flagged.description:
Whether the case counts as flagged (scoped to the twin's family
for twins; any finding for other controls).

oneOf.description: `T0`: expectation pending review; observed but never scored.
The scanner produced no usable observation. Never a `MISS`.

status.description: The scanner status that prevented measurement.

CaseResult.description:
The outcome of one case for one scanner. Self-verifying: `expected` and
`actual` suffice to recompute `measurement` under the protocol.

actual.description: Findings on this case's path, sorted by `(start, end)`.

family.description: Family (format contract) of the case, if any.

group.description: Corpus group / category of the case (`Case.grouping.group`).

targets.description:
Families the case targets (`Case.grouping.targets`; reporting strata
only). Sorted, unique; omitted when empty.

twin_mutation_kind.description: Mutated property of an authored twin (`Case.twin.mutation_kind`), if any.

twin_of.description: Positive case this control is a twin of, if any.

oneOf.description: Both scanners observed the variant.
At least one scanner did not complete.
At least one scanner is unsupported.

DifferentialComparison.description:
A differential observation between two scanners on one variant. Neither
scanner is ground truth; a disagreement is an observation, not a failure.

classification_compared.description:
Whether classifications were comparable (`true`) or not (`false`),
when `status` is `complete`.

reference.description: Reference scanner (run configuration choice, not a truth claim).

Disagreement.description: Kind of disagreement between a reference scanner and a peer.

oneOf.description: Identical ranges (and classifications, where comparable).
Only the reference scanner reported ranges.
Only the peer reported ranges.
Both reported ranges, and they differ.
Ranges agree; mapped families differ.

EvidenceTier.description:
Evidence tier of a case's expectation. `T0` means the expectation is
pending review: the case is observed but never scored.

oneOf.description: Pending review; unscored.
Tier 1 evidence.
Tier 2 evidence.
Tier 3 evidence.

ExecutionDiagnostics.description: Scheduling and timing diagnostics of a run. Never measurements.

evaluator_ms.description:
Evaluator-owned time, in milliseconds: corpus loading, materialization,
output normalization, scoring and serialization (summed over jobs).

jobs.description: Effective global job bound the run was scheduled with.

processes.description: Scanner process invocations that ran (version probes and scans).

scanner_process_ms.description:
Sum of scanner process wall-clock times, in milliseconds. With
parallel jobs this can exceed `wall_ms`.

wall_ms.description: Wall-clock time of the whole run, in milliseconds.

Floor.description: A floor: one value, or a default plus per-key overrides.

anyOf.description: The same floor for every key.

default.description: Floor for keys without an override.

oneOf.description: `pending/T0`: counted, never scored.

candidate_kinds.description: T0 cases by the kind their evidence proposes.

oneOf.description: `must-not-flag/<tier>`: false-alarm measurement.
`must-redact/<tier>` or `policy/<tier>`: span measurements.

envelope_width.description: Authored envelope widening over secret spans.

leaked_spans.description: Spans with a leaking outcome (PARTIAL or MISS).

pending_files.description: T0 cases whose proposed kind is this group's kind.

MethodIdentity.description: An evaluation method and its version.

oneOf.description: No network access is expected or permitted (default posture).
The run explicitly authorizes network access (e.g. verification).

NonSemantic.description:
Non-semantic run metadata. Two runs of identical inputs may differ here
and nowhere else.

durations_ms.description: Scanner wall-clock durations in milliseconds, by scanner id.

execution.description: How the run was scheduled and where its time went.

host.description: Host diagnostics (OS/arch); never paths or usernames.

NormalizedFinding.description:
A normalized finding: a file and a UTF-8 byte range, plus optional
scanner-reported classification. Never the matched value.

action.description:
Disposition the scanner itself reported for the finding (e.g. a
redaction action), when it reports one. Observation only.

family.description:
Credential family the adapter mapped the scanner's rule to, when the
mapping is known. Unmapped rules carry no family (never guessed).

path.description: Fixture path the finding is in.

ObservedRange.description: A finding range on one case.

oneOf.description: A finding equals the span exactly.
A finding contains the span and lies within the acceptable envelope.
Findings contain the span but every containing finding exceeds the envelope.
Findings overlap the span without containing it. Leaks.
No finding overlaps the span. Leaks.

OutcomeCounts.description: Span outcome counts, keyed by outcome name.

PositiveDiagnostics.description: Exact-match diagnostics for positives (not comparable across scanners).

fp.description: Findings not exactly equal to any secret span.

ProvenanceComponent.description: One executable, runtime or package that took part in a scan.

integrity.description: npm Subresource Integrity string from the lockfile, for packages.

name.description: Name: the configured program name, or the npm package name.

sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the component's bytes (an executable file, a lockfile, or a
package tree digest).

version.description: Version, when the component reports or declares one.

oneOf.description: A scanner executable resolved from the configured program.
A language runtime that hosts a shim (e.g. `node`).
A shim script the adapter runs.
A lockfile pinning the packages.
An installed npm package.

Published.description:
A published figure: a rate with its pessimistic bound, or an explicit
withholding. Where a figure is nullable, `null` means a zero denominator.

bound.description: Pessimistic Wilson endpoint; `null` for unbounded ratios.

direction.description: Which side is pessimistic; `null` for ratios.

n.description: Sample size the bound was computed with.

Relation.description: Expected relation between a variant and its canonical baseline.

oneOf.description: Detection must be unchanged.
Detection must disappear.

agreed.description: Whether all replays produced identical normalized findings.

count.description: Number of scans over identical input.

ReviewOccurrence.description:
One entry of the review queue: an occurrence that needs an authored
decision. Neither scanner of a disagreement is ground truth.

id.description:
Stable canonical id. It binds the case, its source digest and the
observation, and excludes every part of the reference scanner's
identity except its id, so reference releases do not re-key reviews.

accounting.description: Accounting parameters the aggregates were computed with.

config_hash.description: Canonical digest of the run configuration.

evidence.description: Identity of the evidence snapshot, including its corpus digest.

methods.description: Evaluation methods applied, sorted by id.

protocol_version.description: Measurement protocol version (independent of the engine version).

scanners.description: Scanner identities, sorted by id. Includes failed/unavailable scanners.

ScannerIdentity.description: Recorded identity of an executed scanner.

configuration_hash.description: Canonical digest of the scanner configuration.

provenance.description:
Setup provenance recorded by the adapter: the network posture and the
digests of the executables and packages that actually ran. Absent in
replayed or canned observations that did not record it.

version.description:
Reported scanner version; `null` when it could not be determined
(e.g. the scanner is unavailable).

ScannerProvenance.description:
How a scanner was set up for a run. Every field is a reproduction
identity: it names bytes (by digest) and versions, never host paths.

components.description: Executables, runtimes and packages that ran, sorted by `(kind, name)`.

network.description: Network posture the adapter ran the scanner under.

network_controls.description:
What the adapter did to keep the posture, e.g.
`["--no-verification", "--no-update"]`. Sorted, unique.

assertions.description: Method assertions, sorted by `(case_id, method, variant, baseline, candidate, assertion)`.

cases.description: One result per corpus case, sorted by case id.

detail.description: Sanitized status detail for non-complete scanners.

findings.description:
Deduplicated normalized findings, sorted by `(path, start, end)`.
Empty unless `status` is `complete`.

scanner.description: Scanner id (identity is in the manifest).

status.description: Execution status. Anything but `complete` means not measured.

ScannerStatus.description: Status of a scanner within a run.

oneOf.description: Observed; findings are scored.
Replays disagreed; not measured.
Adapter cannot produce ranges; not measured.
Scanner not available; not measured.
Timed out; not measured.
Output unparseable or over limits; not measured.
Other failure; not measured.

ScoredSpan.description: An expected span as embedded in results.

SnapshotIdentity.description: Identity of the evidence a snapshot was taken from.

evidence_schema.description: Schema/revision label of the source evidence format.

revision.description: Immutable revision of the source (commit SHA or release tag).

source.description:
Evidence source, e.g. `credential-evidence` or
`legacy:redact-secret-benchmarks` during migration.

oneOf.description: Credential bytes that must be covered. Scored by the lattice.

Bytes that may be covered without collateral (e.g. a paired key id).
Not scored as a span; counts as acceptable coverage.

TwinMeasurement.description: Twin discrimination measurement for a positive group.

co_detected.description: Pairs whose twin was co-detected by a different known family.

discriminated.description: Pairs where every positive span is EXACT/COVERED and the twin is not flagged.

positives.description: Scored positives in the group (the twin denominator population).

rate.description: discriminated / pairs, lower bound; withheld when unmeasurable or under-covered.

VariantRecord.description: Lineage and identity of one generated variant.

case_id.description: Case the variant was generated from.

content_digest.description: Digest of the variant's content bytes.

operator.description: Operator id (`identity` for the canonical variant).

relation.description: Expected relation to the canonical variant, if any.

variant.description: Variant id within the case (`canonical` or the operator id).

VariantStrategy.description: How a generated variant's expectation was obtained.

oneOf.description: Authored in the evidence (e.g. an authored twin).
Derived by a semantics-preserving operator.
Expectation cannot be derived; the variant is `T0`.
Denominator below `min_denominator`, or measurable share below its floor.
Twin coverage below its floor.
